header: Seals, each linked to its certificate
text: One to ten marks, each named in text under its image. Readers can identify an unfamiliar seal, and each link gets a distinct name.
note: Put validity dates and certificate numbers here, where an expired seal is easy to spot and remove. An expired seal is worse than none.
